description_expanded: Escape to 'Seaview Escape', a luxurious 4-bedroom home in Inlet Beach, Florida. This newly renovated coastal retreat boasts modern design, two master suites, and a rooftop terrace with Gulf views and stunning sunsets. Enjoy beach access, a communal pool, and family-friendly amenities for an unforgettable vacation. Upon entering, you'll be greeted by a beautiful foyer on the first floor, leading to the first master suite. This suite features a king bed, a queen sleeper sofa, and a pub table with two stools. It includes an ensuite bathroom with dual sinks and a walk-in shower, plus a private entrance to a walk-out patio and outdoor shower. The second floor boasts an open-concept living area with a kitchen, stainless steel appliances, and quartz countertops, a dining area, and a cozy living room opening to a balcony. Two bedrooms are located on this floor: one with a queen bed and a connected bunk room with full bunks and a pullout twin trundle, and another with a king bed. A full bathroom with a shower/tub combo is available for both second-floor bedrooms. The third level houses the second master suite, offering a king-size bed, a queen sleeper sofa, a desk, and an ensuite with dual sinks and a walk-in shower. Step outside to a rooftop terrace with custom turf, Adirondack chairs, an outdoor sectional sofa, a half-bathroom with a small refrigerator, string lights, and a glimpse of the Gulf of Mexico. The oversized garage provides a ping pong table, beach essentials, a gas grill, and a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer. The driveway accommodates two cars, with additional street parking available. The community pool is just steps away. Guests have access to the entire house, including the four bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, kitchen, living areas, and outdoor spaces. Enjoy the amenities such as the BBQ grill, patio, and access to the communal pool. Please note that the owner's closets are locked and not accessible. Nestled in the charming Inlet Beach, 'Seaview Escape' offers an ideal location for your beach vacation. You're just steps away from the pristine white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. A short stroll will take you to local dining favorites like The Donut Hole, perfect for a quick breakfast, or The Terrace at 30A, offering delightful seafood and stunning views. For shopping, head to 30Avenue, a vibrant outdoor lifestyle center, a quick drive or bike ride away, filled with boutiques, restaurants, and entertainment options. The area is known for its relaxed atmosphere, perfect for families and those seeking a tranquil getaway. Explore the nearby iconic beaches and coastal dune lakes, and discover the unique beauty of this sought-after coastal community. We are available to assist you throughout your stay! You can reach us via your chosen platform with any questions or concerns. We typically respond within a few hours, but rest assured—we’ll do our best to get back to you as quickly as possible. For urgent matters, please note it in your message. We’re committed to ensuring you have a fantastic vacation experience! Please note: Any beach chairs, umbrellas, toys, coolers, pack n plays, and baby gear available are provided as a complimentary amenity. LUXE 30A does not guarantee the inclusion or perfect working order of these items. They are not part of the rental agreement. The primary renter must be 25 years of age or older, with at least one guest aged 25+ for every three guests in the group. Getting around 'Seaview Escape' is easy! Free parking is available in the driveway for two cars, and street parking is also readily accessible. For those flying in, Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) is approximately a 30-minute drive away. While public transportation options are limited in Inlet Beach, the area is very walkable and bike-friendly, allowing you to explore local attractions, restaurants, and the beautiful beaches with ease. Consider using ride-sharing services for longer trips. Enjoy your stay!
